status: DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED, but REFUTED as the cause of run 4's regression. The miscalibration was real; it was not what broke the policy.
summary: The entropy target -8.4 is documented as corresponding to 'exploration std ~0.20'. Measured against the trainer's own log-probability computation, it does not. In the correlated-noise branch it is reachable only near std 0.05; in the i.i.d. branch it is not reachable at ANY std. Run 4 therefore spent its entire length under entropy pressure toward a target its configuration could not satisfy.

how_it_was_found.trigger: Run 4 warm-started from a policy with v3 grasp 1.00 and evaluated at 0.00, while every training diagnostic looked healthy: critic loss 1.24 -> 0.076, Q 0.65 -> 2.58, logp descending -5.59 -> -7.55 in the CORRECT direction, demo_fraction 0.5 throughout.
how_it_was_found.first_hypothesis_refuted: That the in-trainer evaluation disagreed with eval_checkpoint.py. Scoring run 4's checkpoint with the independent tool that gave BC 1.00 returned grasp 0.00, matching the in-trainer number exactly. The regression is real, not a measurement artifact.
how_it_was_found.the_anomaly_that_located_it: The action head barely moved: mean |delta| ~0.0005 per tensor against BC. Yet the DEPLOYED action error went 0.403 -> 13.773 degrees, a 34x degradation, because the tanh squash amplifies small pre-squash changes. The raw head output also shrank, 0.4151 -> 0.2364, which is the signature of a policy being flattened toward the squash's linear centre rather than one that learned something different.

measurement.method: Drive the trainer's OWN log-probability computation (both branches, verbatim) at a range of exploration stds, mean 0, active dims only, per control action.

correlated_noise_branch_used_by_run_4.reading: -8.4 is reachable only at std ~0.05, the MINIMUM of the useful range, not the documented 0.20.

iid_branch.reading: -8.4 is not reachable at any std. The quantity is positive throughout.

mechanism_of_the_regression.observed: actor_logstd was reset to 0.20 at warm start (correctly, per the policy-only warm-start rule). The run then sat at logp -7.55 against a target of -8.4, so the residual never reached zero and alpha ROSE 57% (0.0512 -> 0.0802) across the run.
mechanism_of_the_regression.consequence: The entropy term averaged 28% of the actor objective for the entire run, pushing the policy toward higher entropy the whole time. Because the head's output is pre-squash, that pressure flattens it toward zero, and the squash converts a small weight change into a large executed-action change.
mechanism_of_the_regression.why_the_online_rate_looked_survivable: Online (stochastic) episodes grasped ~41% flat from episode 0 with no downward trend, while deterministic evaluation was 0.00. That inversion -- noise apparently HELPING -- is consistent with a mean that has been flattened: the injected noise partially restores action magnitude that the flattened mean no longer provides.

relationship_to_the_sign_bug: g1_piston_entropy_target_sign.json fixed the DIRECTION of the alpha update, and that fix is confirmed working here: logp moved toward -8.4 rather than away from it. This contract is about the VALUE of the target, which is a separate defect the sign fix could not reveal. Run 3 collapsed because alpha fell; run 4 regressed because alpha rose toward an unreachable target. Both are entropy defects, with opposite signs.
what_this_does_not_affect: The behaviour-cloning policy itself, which is unchanged and still scores grasp 1.00, lift 0.80 (verified_results/videos_bc_working/).
The specification-gaming finding, the plunger-DoF finding, and the two BC train/deploy defects, all of which are measurements of other things.
status_of_run_4: REPORTED AS A REGRESSION per the pre-registered H4 rule in g1_piston_v3_retrain_run4_preregistration.json: v3 grasp fell below 0.87, so the run is reported as a regression whatever happened to press and dispense. Press and dispense were 0.00. The pre-registration is honoured exactly; the cause is now identified rather than left as 'RL did not work'.
lesson: A target expressed in units of a log-density is only meaningful relative to the exact log-probability computation it is compared against. TARGET_ENTROPY_STD documents an std, but nothing verified that the target and the std agree under the branch actually in use -- and the two branches disagree with each other by ~15 nats at the same std.

refutation_by_run_5.test: Run 5 repeated run 4 with the calibrated target (-7.30, measured for the correlated branch at std 0.25) as the ONLY change.

but_the_policy_still_collapsed.eval_grasp: 0.00 at 30k, 60k and 90k env steps, identical to run 4
but_the_policy_still_collapsed.H4: FAILED. Run 5 is a regression under the pre-registered rule.

refutation_by_run_5.conclusion: The entropy target was NOT the cause of the regression. This contract's original claim to 'explain run 4's regression' is WITHDRAWN. The calibration defect is real and the fix is kept, but it is not the mechanism that flattens the policy.

what_the_signature_actually_is.reading: Both runs flatten the head's output and blow up the executed action, and the calibrated target barely moved either number.

ruled_out_by_measurement.smoothness_penalty: SMOOTH_LAMBDA=100 contributes 0.011 against Q~2.45, under 0.5% of the actor objective. Not the cause.

leading_hypothesis_now_UNTESTED.claim: The demonstration-conditioned critic is confidently wrong.
leading_hypothesis_now_UNTESTED.mechanism: RLPD fills half of every batch with demonstration transitions, so the critic learns values for actions the policy never takes. Q tracks the demonstrations (11.88) rather than the policy (-0.66), and the actor ascends that inflated estimate away from behaviour that works.
leading_hypothesis_now_UNTESTED.decisive_cheap_test: Same setup with DEMO_FRAC=0 (plain SAC from the BC policy). If grasp survives, the demo-conditioned critic is the cause; if it collapses identically, the cause is in the actor update itself.
leading_hypothesis_now_UNTESTED.status: NOT TESTED. Stated as a hypothesis, not a finding. Two prior confident diagnoses in this project failed in a row.
